title: M2K: Making the Model-Kernel Interface Explicit for Reliable CUDA Kernel Verification
abstract: arXiv:2603.24595v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference systems rely on CUDA kernels for core GPU computations, yet the interface between models and kernels is implicit and poorly specified. Models and kernels evolve independently and often make incompatible assumptions about tensor shapes and input sizes, leading to subtle memory bugs in CUDA kernels. These bugs can crash inference services, corrupt model weights, or be exploited by remote adversaries. Existing techniques either incur prohibitive runtime overhead, require specialized hardware, or fail to handle dynamic tensor shapes and variable kernel launch configurations, leaving the CUDA memory bugs largely unaddressed.   This paper presents M2K, a fully automated framework that makes the model-kernel interface explicit and leverages it to detect memory bugs in CUDA kernels used in LLM inference systems. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理系统依赖CUDA内核来完成核心的GPU计算，然而模型与内核之间的接口是隐式的且缺乏明确规范。模型和内核独立演进，常常对张量形状和输入大小做出不兼容的假设，从而导致CUDA内核中出现隐蔽的内存错误。这些错误可能导致推理服务崩溃、损坏模型权重，或被远程攻击者利用。现有技术要么带来难以承受的运行时开销，要么需要专用硬件，要么无法处理动态张量形状和可变的内核启动配置，使得CUDA内存错误问题在很大程度上尚未得到解决。本文提出M2K，一个完全自动化的框架，它使模型-内核接口显式化，并利用该接口来检测LLM推理系统中所使用的CUDA内核的内存错误。M2K由两个组件组成：HFProbe无需GPU硬件即可追踪模型执行，cla……
tldr: M2K是一个完全自动化的框架，通过将LLM模型与CUDA内核之间的隐式接口显式化，无需专用硬件即可可靠地检测推理系统中CUDA内核的内存错误。
en_tdlr: M2K is a fully automated framework that makes the implicit model-kernel interface explicit, enabling reliable detection of memory bugs in CUDA kernels used in LLM inference systems without requiring specialized hardware.
